grammar.explanation: The event after 一 triggers the result after 就. Subjects may differ. This pattern is about the relationship between events, not a promise that practice succeeds.

examples.zh: 音乐一响，我就跟不上了。
examples.py: yīn yuè yī xiǎng , wǒ jiù gēn bù shàng le .
examples.en: As soon as the music starts, I can’t keep up.

examples.zh: 她一到家就给我打电话。
examples.py: tā yī dào jiā jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà .
examples.en: She calls me as soon as she gets home.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一音乐响，我就跟不上了。
commonMistakes.right: 音乐一响，我就跟不上了。
commonMistakes.why: Put 一 immediately before the triggering verb.

grammar.purpose: Track what happens to a known object
grammar.explanation: 把 introduces a specific affected object before a verb with a result, location or other completion. In a verse the object or result can be figurative; the grammar alone does not make the image literal.

examples.py: bǎ lù yīn fā gěi wǒ .
bǎ zhè jù huà dú qīng chǔ .

commonMistakes.why: In this request, give the destination rather than leaving the action incomplete.

grammar.explanation: Reject one interpretation and supply the more fitting one. Keep the two clauses comparable.

examples.zh: 这不是说明天是一件东西，而是在说还想再见。
examples.py: zhè bù shì shuō míng tiān shì yī jiàn dōng xi , ér shì zài shuō hái xiǎng zài jiàn .
examples.en: It doesn’t mean tomorrow is an object; it means wanting to meet again.

examples.zh: 我不是不练，而是想先弄懂。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì bù liàn , ér shì xiǎng xiān nòng dǒng .
examples.en: It isn’t that I won’t practise; I want to understand first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不是想先弄懂，而是想先弄懂。
commonMistakes.right: 我不是不练，而是想先弄懂。
commonMistakes.why: Identical alternatives do not clarify the misunderstanding.

grammar.explanation: 先 and 再 order actions. 每次都 says an action happens on every occasion; it does not itself mean the action is useful.

examples.py: xiān dú qīng chǔ , zài gēn yīn yuè .
examples.en: Read clearly first, then try with the music.

examples.py: bié měi cì dōu cóng tóu kāi shǐ .
examples.en: Don’t start from the beginning every time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 先跟音乐，再读清楚，所以第一步是读。
commonMistakes.why: The stated first step must match the order of the clauses.

dialogue.title: 先听懂，再跟着唱
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 这两句你已经重复好多遍了，还没唱顺？
lines.py: zhè liǎng jù nǐ yǐ jīng chóng fù hǎo duō biàn le , hái méi chàng shùn ?
lines.en: You’ve repeated those two lines so many times. Still not smooth?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 字我都认识，可是一跟音乐就来不及。
lines.py: zì wǒ dōu rèn shi , kě shì yī gēn yīn yuè jiù lái bù jí .
lines.en: I know all the words, but I can’t keep up with the music.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先别放音乐。把它当成一句话，读给我听。
lines.py: xiān bié fàng yīn yuè . bǎ tā dàng chéng yī jù huà , dú gěi wǒ tīng .
lines.en: Leave the music off for now. Treat it as a sentence and read it to me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: “把歌声留在窗边，把明天带回来。”明天怎么带回来？
lines.py: bǎ gē shēng liú zài chuāng biān , bǎ míng tiān dài huí lái . míng tiān zěn me dài huí lái ?
lines.en: “Leave the song by the window; bring tomorrow back.” How can you bring tomorrow back?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我觉得是在说想再见到那个人。不是有人真的拿着一个明天。
lines.py: wǒ jué de shì zài shuō xiǎng zài jiàn dào nà gè rén . bù shì yǒu rén zhēn de ná zhe yī gè míng tiān .
lines.en: I think it means wanting to see someone again. Nobody’s literally carrying a tomorrow.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以这句不是在讲一个动作？
lines.py: suǒ yǐ zhè jù bù shì zài jiǎng yī gè dòng zuò ?
lines.en: So it isn’t describing an actual action?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有动作的样子，但意思得连着前面的“等你”看。
lines.py: yǒu dòng zuò de yàng zi , dàn yì si děi lián zhe qián miàn de děng nǐ kàn .
lines.en: It looks like an action, but you need to read it with the earlier “waiting for you.”
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 懂了。那我先读清楚，再试着唱，行吗？
lines.py: dǒng le . nà wǒ xiān dú qīng chǔ , zài shì zhe chàng , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Got it. I’ll read it clearly first, then try singing. Okay?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。录一小段就好，别一开始就从头唱到尾。
lines.py: xíng . lù yī xiǎo duàn jiù hǎo , bié yī kāi shǐ jiù cóng tóu chàng dào wěi .
lines.en: Sure. Just record a short part. Don’t try the whole thing from the start.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你听的时候不许笑。
lines.py: nǐ tīng de shí hou bù xǔ xiào .
lines.en: You’re not allowed to laugh when you listen.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那要看你唱什么了。我只能保证认真听。
lines.py: nà yào kàn nǐ chàng shén me le . wǒ zhǐ néng bǎo zhèng rèn zhēn tīng .
lines.en: That depends on what you sing. I can only promise to listen properly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好吧，认真听也行。先帮我看看这两个字。
lines.py: hǎo ba , rèn zhēn tīng yě xíng . xiān bāng wǒ kàn kàn zhè liǎng gè zì .
lines.en: Fine, listening properly will do. Help me check these two characters first.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What does the friend suggest first?
choices: Read the words as speech without music
questions.answer: Read the words as speech without music

choices: Never to laugh under any circumstances

questions.q: Why refer to the earlier “waiting for you”?
choices: It gives context for the figurative final line
It proves tomorrow can be carried
It supplies the price of the song
questions.answer: It gives context for the figurative final line

reading.title: 先听懂，再跟着唱
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 第一次练这段歌时，我以为只要每个字都认识，就能跟着唱。结果音乐一响，我连第一句都没唱完，后面的字已经来了。
lines.py: dì yī cì liàn zhè duàn gē shí , wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào měi gè zì dōu rèn shi , jiù néng gēn zhe chàng . jié guǒ yīn yuè yī xiǎng , wǒ lián dì yī jù dōu méi chàng wán , hòu miàn de zì yǐ jīng lái le .
lines.en: When I first practised this verse, I thought knowing every character would let me sing along. Once the music started, I hadn’t finished the first line before the next words arrived.

lines.zh: 我关掉音乐，先读歌词。里面有窗边的灯、雨后的影子，还有一个人在等朋友回来。那些东西不难理解，可是最后两句不能只按字面看。
lines.py: wǒ guān diào yīn yuè , xiān dú gē cí . lǐ miàn yǒu chuāng biān de dēng , yǔ hòu de yǐng zi , hái yǒu yī gè rén zài děng péng you huí lái . nà xiē dōng xi bù nán lǐ jiě , kě shì zuì hòu liǎng jù bù néng zhǐ àn zì miàn kàn .
lines.en: I switched off the music and read the words. There was a light by a window, a shadow after rain and someone waiting for a friend. Those details were clear, but the last two lines needed more than a literal reading.

lines.zh: 朋友问我：“前面谁在等谁？”我才发现自己一直注意快不快，没有想过这段到底在说什么。
lines.py: péng you wèn wǒ : qián miàn shéi zài děng shéi ? wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yì zhí zhù yì kuài bù kuài , méi yǒu xiǎng guò zhè duàn dào dǐ zài shuō shén me .
lines.en: My friend asked, “Who is waiting for whom earlier?” I realised I’d only been thinking about speed, not what the verse was saying.

lines.zh: 我们把八句分成四小段。我先读一句，讲清意思，再跟着音乐试一次。遇到连在一起的几个字，就单独重复，而不是每次都从头开始。
lines.py: wǒ men bǎ bā jù fēn chéng sì xiǎo duàn . wǒ xiān dú yī jù , jiǎng qīng yì si , zài gēn zhe yīn yuè shì yī cì . yù dào lián zài yì qǐ de jǐ gè zì , jiù dān dú chóng fù , ér bù shì měi cì dōu cóng tóu kāi shǐ .
lines.en: We divided the eight lines into four short sections. I read a line, explained its meaning and then tried it with the music. I practised difficult clusters separately instead of restarting each time.

lines.zh: 后来我录了两次。第一次声音太小，第二次字清楚了，速度却还是有点慢。朋友没有说我已经唱好了，只指出我这次没有漏掉“等你”。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ lù le liǎng cì . dì yī cì shēng yīn tài xiǎo , dì èr cì zì qīng chǔ le , sù dù què hái shi yǒu diǎn màn . péng you méi yǒu shuō wǒ yǐ jīng chàng hǎo le , zhǐ zhǐ chū wǒ zhè cì méi yǒu lòu diào děng nǐ .
lines.en: Later I made two recordings. The first was too quiet; in the second the words were clear but still a little slow. My friend didn’t say I’d mastered it, just that I hadn’t missed “waiting for you” this time.

lines.zh: 现在我仍然会错，不过知道下一次要练哪一小段了。先懂意思再练速度，比把不懂的声音唱得很快更有用。
lines.py: xiàn zài wǒ réng rán huì cuò , bù guò zhī dào xià yī cì yào liàn nǎ yī xiǎo duàn le . xiān dǒng yì si zài liàn sù dù , bǐ bǎ bù dǒng de shēng yīn chàng de hěn kuài gèng yǒu yòng .
lines.en: I still make mistakes, but I know which short section to practise next. Understanding first and then practising speed is more useful than singing unclear sounds quickly.

questions.q: What changes in the narrator’s practice?
choices: Meaning and short sections come before speed
questions.answer: Meaning and short sections come before speed

questions.q: Which phrase is no longer missed in the second recording?

choices: Finding someone willing to hear a recording

extraReadings.title: Original verse: the window light
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 雨停以后，路还没干。
lines.py: yǔ tíng yǐ hòu , lù hái méi gàn .
lines.en: After the rain stops, the road is still wet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你的影子，留在门前。
lines.py: nǐ de yǐng zi , liú zài mén qián .
lines.en: Your shadow stays in front of the door.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 窗边的灯，亮了一晚。
lines.py: chuāng biān de dēng , liàng le yī wǎn .
lines.en: The light by the window shines all night.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我等你说，明天再见。
lines.py: wǒ děng nǐ shuō , míng tiān zài jiàn .
lines.en: I wait for you to say, “See you tomorrow.”
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 别让一句话，走得太远。
lines.py: bié ràng yī jù huà , zǒu de tài yuǎn .
lines.en: Don’t let a sentence wander too far.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有些想念，没说也听见。
lines.py: yǒu xiē xiǎng niàn , méi shuō yě tīng jiàn .
lines.en: Some longing can be heard even without words.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 把歌声留在窗边。
lines.py: bǎ gē shēng liú zài chuāng biān .
lines.en: Leave the song by the window.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 把明天带回来。
lines.py: bǎ míng tiān dài huí lái .
lines.en: Bring tomorrow back.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Who is waiting for a farewell about tomorrow?
Which reading best fits “把明天带回来”?
choices: A literal instruction to carry a date
A claim that the rain will never stop

extraReadings.title: Understand the verse before rushing it: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 先听懂，再跟着唱 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 她的声音很优美。
lines.py: tā de shēng yīn hěn yōu měi .
lines.en: Her voice is beautiful.

lines.zh: 这篇文章的语言优美，但不难懂。
lines.py: zhè piān wén zhāng de yǔ yán yōu měi , dàn bù nán dǒng .
lines.en: This article uses beautiful language without being hard to understand.

lines.zh: 灯下有两个人的影子。
lines.py: dēng xià yǒu liǎng gè rén de yǐng zi .
lines.en: There are two people’s shadows under the light.

lines.zh: 太阳快落山了，树的影子越来越长。
lines.py: tài yáng kuài luò shān le , shù de yǐng zi yuè lái yuè zhǎng .
lines.en: The sun is setting and the tree’s shadow is growing longer.

lines.zh: 这条河很浅，可以看见河底。
lines.py: zhè tiáo hé hěn qiǎn , kě yǐ kàn jiàn hé dǐ .
lines.en: This river is shallow; you can see the bottom.

lines.zh: 我想买一件颜色浅一点的外套。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn yán sè qiǎn yī diǎn de wài tào .
lines.en: I’d like a coat in a lighter colour.

lines.zh: 今晚由她演唱最后一首歌。
lines.py: jīn wǎn yóu tā yǎn chàng zuì hòu yī shǒu gē .
lines.en: She’ll sing the final song tonight.

lines.zh: 这首歌第一次公开演唱时，他还很年轻。
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē dì yī cì gōng kāi yǎn chàng shí , tā hái hěn nián qīng .
lines.en: He was very young when he first sang this song in public.

lines.zh: 我想录音，听听哪里唱得不清楚。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng lù yīn , tīng tīng nǎ lǐ chàng de bù qīng chǔ .
lines.en: I’d like to record myself and hear which parts aren’t clear.

lines.zh: 这段录音只有一分钟。
lines.py: zhè duàn lù yīn zhǐ yǒu yī fēn zhōng .
lines.en: This recording is only a minute long.

lines.zh: 这句话请再重复一次。
lines.py: zhè jù huà qǐng zài chóng fù yī cì .
lines.en: Please repeat this sentence once more.

lines.zh: 我不想每天重复同样的错误。
lines.py: wǒ bù xiǎng měi tiān chóng fù tóng yàng de cuò wù .
lines.en: I don’t want to repeat the same mistakes every day.

lines.zh: 换了位置以后，录音效果好多了。
lines.py: huàn le wèi zhì yǐ hòu , lù yīn xiào guǒ hǎo duō le .
lines.en: The recording sounds much better after we moved.

lines.zh: 这个方法的效果要过几天才能看出来。
lines.py: zhè gè fāng fǎ de xiào guǒ yào guò jǐ tiān cái néng kàn chū lái .
lines.en: It’ll take a few days to see how well this method works.

lines.zh: 这个包很轻，你拿吧。
lines.py: zhè gè bāo hěn qīng , nǐ ná ba .
lines.en: This bag is light; you can carry it.

lines.zh: 关门轻一点，孩子在睡觉。
lines.py: guān mén qīng yī diǎn , hái zi zài shuì jiào .
lines.en: Close the door gently; the child is asleep.

lines.zh: 这条河中间很深。
lines.py: zhè tiáo hé zhōng jiān hěn shēn .
lines.en: The middle of this river is deep.

lines.zh: 深蓝色那件更适合你。
lines.py: shēn lán sè nà jiàn gèng shì hé nǐ .
lines.en: The dark blue one suits you better.

lines.zh: 冬天的阳光照在身上很温暖。
lines.py: dōng tiān de yáng guāng zhào zài shēn shàng hěn wēn nuǎn .
lines.en: The winter sunlight feels warm on my skin.

lines.zh: 这封信让我感到温暖。
lines.py: zhè fēng xìn ràng wǒ gǎn dào wēn nuǎn .
lines.en: This letter made me feel cared for.

lines.zh: 屋里很静，只听见钟的声音。
lines.py: wū lǐ hěn jìng , zhǐ tīng jiàn zhōng de shēng yīn .
lines.en: The room is quiet; only the clock can be heard.

lines.zh: 请让孩子静一会儿。
lines.py: qǐng ràng hái zi jìng yī huì er .
lines.en: Please let the child have a quiet moment.

lines.zh: 他们认识很久了，感情很好。
lines.py: tā men rèn shi hěn jiǔ le , gǎn qíng hěn hǎo .
lines.en: They’ve known each other a long time and are very close.

lines.zh: 唱得很准，却没什么感情。
lines.py: chàng de hěn zhǔn , què méi shén me gǎn qíng .
lines.en: The singing is accurate but has little feeling.

lines.zh: 我听见楼下有人说话的声音。
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiàn lóu xià yǒu rén shuō huà de shēng yīn .
lines.en: I heard people talking downstairs.

lines.zh: 你的声音太小，我听不清。
lines.py: nǐ de shēng yīn tài xiǎo , wǒ tīng bù qīng .
lines.en: Your voice is too quiet for me to hear clearly.

lines.zh: 这个动作先慢慢练。
lines.py: zhè gè dòng zuò xiān màn màn liàn .
lines.en: Practise this movement slowly first.

lines.zh: 她的动作很快，转眼就收好了。
lines.py: tā de dòng zuò hěn kuài , zhuǎn yǎn jiù shōu hǎo le .
lines.en: She moved quickly and had everything packed in a moment.

lines.zh: 这边太暗，看不清字。
lines.py: zhè biān tài àn , kàn bù qīng zì .
lines.en: It’s too dark here to read the words.

lines.zh: 天还没完全暗，我们出去走走吧。
lines.py: tiān hái méi wán quán àn , wǒ men chū qù zǒu zǒu ba .
lines.en: It isn’t completely dark yet; let’s take a walk.

lines.zh: 这件衣服是纯棉的。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú shì chún mián de .
lines.en: This garment is pure cotton.

lines.zh: 我想点一杯纯果汁，不加水。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng diǎn yī bēi chún guǒ zhī , bù jiā shuǐ .
lines.en: I’d like pure fruit juice with no water added.

turns.meaning: Are you recording the whole song?

natural.zh: 帮我听听这两个字清不清楚。
natural.py: bāng wǒ tīng tīng zhè liǎng gè zì qīng bù qīng chǔ .
natural.en: Help me hear whether these two characters are clear.

pragmatics.note: The request asks about a defined segment rather than an invented overall pronunciation score.

natural.zh: 我觉得这里是在说想再见。
natural.py: wǒ jué de zhè lǐ shì zài shuō xiǎng zài jiàn .
natural.en: I think this means wanting to meet again.

pragmatics.note: 我觉得 marks your interpretation; nearby lines provide the evidence.

audio.zh: 行。录一小段就好，别一开始就从头唱到尾。
audio.py: xíng . lù yī xiǎo duàn jiù hǎo , bié yī kāi shǐ jiù cóng tóu chàng dào wěi .
audio.en: Sure. Just record a short part. Don’t try the whole thing from the start.

tasks.statement: The friend recommends recording a short section.
tasks.why: 录一小段 explicitly recommends a short section.

audio.zh: 后来我录了两次。第一次声音太小，第二次字清楚了，速度却还是有点慢。朋友没有说我已经唱好了，只指出我这次没有漏掉“等你”。
audio.py: hòu lái wǒ lù le liǎng cì . dì yī cì shēng yīn tài xiǎo , dì èr cì zì qīng chǔ le , sù dù què hái shi yǒu diǎn màn . péng you méi yǒu shuō wǒ yǐ jīng chàng hǎo le , zhǐ zhǐ chū wǒ zhè cì méi yǒu lòu diào děng nǐ .
audio.en: Later I made two recordings. The first was too quiet; in the second the words were clear but still a little slow. My friend didn’t say I’d mastered it, just that I hadn’t missed “waiting for you” this time.

tasks.statement: The second recording was already perfectly at the musical pace.
tasks.why: It was clearer but still a little slow.

prompt.zh: 字能读清楚，一跟音乐就来不及。怎么办？
prompt.py: zì néng dú qīng chǔ , yī gēn yīn yuè jiù lái bù jí . zěn me bàn ?
prompt.en: I can read the words clearly, but fall behind with the music. What should I do?

choices: 既然能读清楚，就已经完全跟上音乐了。
不用看意思，把整首加快唱完就行。
tasks.why: The reply offers the manageable practice described.

prompt.zh: 前面说在等朋友，最后说把明天带回来。是什么意思？
prompt.py: qián miàn shuō zài děng péng you , zuì hòu shuō bǎ míng tiān dài huí lái . shì shén me yì si ?
prompt.en: Earlier the narrator waits for a friend, then says bring tomorrow back. What does that mean?

choices: 连着前面的等你看，可能是在说想再见。
是在要求朋友把一个日期拿在手里。
是在确定朋友已经回来，再也不用等。
tasks.answer: 连着前面的等你看，可能是在说想再见。
tasks.why: The reply uses a contextual interpretation rather than literal objects.
